lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's eleven? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 11? Nope!

lines.text: How many triangles have whole-number sides and a perimeter of twenty-four?
lines.caption: How many triangles have whole-number sides and a perimeter of 24?

lines.text: Same three sides count only once.
lines.caption: Same 3 sides count only once.

lines.text: The longest side must be under twelve. That's half of twenty-four.
lines.caption: The longest side must be under 12. That's half of 24.

lines.text: Three sevens make only twenty-one. So it's at least eight.
lines.caption: Three 7s make only 21. So it's at least 8.

lines.text: Longest side eleven gives five. Ten gives four. Nine gives two.
lines.caption: Longest side 11 gives 5. 10 gives 4. 9 gives 2.

lines.text: And eight gives just one: eight, eight, eight!
lines.caption: And 8 gives just 1: 8, 8, 8!

lines.text: Five plus four plus two plus one is twelve triangles!
lines.caption: 5 plus 4 plus 2 plus 1 is 12 triangles!

lines.text: Eleven was the trap. It leaves out the equilateral one.
lines.caption: 11 was the trap. It leaves out the equilateral one.

lines.text: Did you get twelve? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 12? Tell me below!
